title: Light Bringer
author: Pierce Brown
summary: The sixth Red Rising book begins a new stage of a bloody saga about class revolt across a colonised solar system. War is spreading, and the heroes must face what their choices have cost. Read the earlier books first.
readIf: you already love Red Rising and want more relentless, high-stakes space war with a huge cast.
skipIf: you are new to the series, since the story depends on the earlier books and spoils them.

pairings.reason: A war epic of similar brutality, with a driven heroine and a steep price for power.
Another long, planet-spanning series with big battles and a growing cast.
An older story of conquest, empire and a leader who becomes a legend.
